note: Gilson Pond Campground, on Dublin Road two miles from Monadnock State Park's headquarters, with trails up the mountain and around Gilson Pond leaving from the campground. Mostly tent, pop-up and platform sites: only six take a 23-ft rig, the RV/Trailer sites A000, A005, A006 and A008 (25-30 ft) and the standard sites A007 and A013 (25 ft). No pets. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 41 sites, max 30 ft, showers/flush toilets/water, RA booking with some first-come sites, $35 (25-ft standard sites; electric RV/Trailer sites $45); season May-Oct with reservable Memorial Day-Columbus Day window; PIN IS 3 km OFF at park headquarters -> move to the Gilson Pond loops; phone should be the park, not RA's call center; note rewritten.
